title: HyperPrism: An Adaptive Non-linear Aggregation Framework for Distributed Machine Learning over Non-IID Data and Time-varying Communication Links
caption: Figure 1: The Overview of HyperPrism Framework. ①Device i executes local update on its own dataset. ② Device i adaptively generates degrees of pθ and pφ for the representation and decision parts by hypernetworks. ③Device i maps the model to the mirror space by raising the parameters with the degree of power pθ and pφ, respectively. ④Device i communicates with its neighbors exchanging local models. ⑤Device i aggregates received models in mirror space with WPM. ⑥Device i inverses the model to primal space by the degree of power pθ and pφ, then finishes the round.
